structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun bonding-curve coin, "Orvix Agent" (Orvix), about 13 minutes old at detection. It went from roughly $3.4k to $34k market cap (+834% in the hour) on about $32k of volume. The packet also shows a same-name token (Pj2Po...pump) created about 5 minutes after this one that is already at $2.1M market cap with $132k of liquidity. That token has clearly won the "Orvix Agent" name, and several other clones are dead near $3.4k. This coin looks like a copy or spillover play riding the winner's attention. Its top 10 holders each sit at a near-identical ~1.45-1.48%, which looks like one bundled distribution. GMGN counts 23 bundler wallets, puts the rat-trader and entrapment trader shares near 62%, and the bot/degen rate at 58%. The dev has launched 25 tokens, and the best of them peaked at about $194k.

narrative.description: An 'AI agent / decentralized AI compute on Solana' story attached to the name Orvix Agent. The story is real in the sense that a same-name token reached $2.1M, but this contract is not that token.

authenticity.evidence: There are 287 unique buyers and 208 unique sellers, so some real breadth. But the top 10 holders have near-identical ~1.47% stakes, which is typical of a bundled or split-wallet setup. GMGN shows 23 bundlers, rat-trader and entrapment trader shares of about 62%, and a 58% bot/degen rate. The dev is a serial launcher (25 tokens). There are no paid boosts and no smart-money or KOL wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: The uniform holder stakes could be organic snipes at similar sizes. Without X data I can't tell whether the project account supports this contract or the $2.1M one.

structural_risks: A same-name competitor at $2.1M holds the canonical status
A bundle of ~10 uniform wallets holding ~14.7% can dump into the curve
Buy/sell counts are close to even in the last 5 minutes (176/160), so the first leg is being distributed

structured_output.thesis: This is a non-canonical clone of a token that has already won, at $2.1M. It has already made its +834% first leg, and its holders look bundled while the dev is a serial launcher. A spillover pump and migration give it some upside, but more likely the bundle distributes into the curve and it bleeds out. It should rank below typical coins in the pool.
